findings.title: A RoleBinding cannot grant a cluster-wide request
findings.cause: container inventory exits because the API server refuses its ServiceAccount inventory: it may not list nodes across the cluster. RoleBinding inventory-reads-nodes binds ClusterRole kd-rbac-clusterrole-rolebinding-node-reader to it, and a RoleBinding grants a ClusterRole's rules in its own namespace, kd-rbac-clusterrole-rolebinding, only; the request is across all namespaces (or of a resource that belongs to no namespace), which only a ClusterRoleBinding grants; its log says: "Error from server (Forbidden): nodes is forbidden: User \"system:serviceaccount:kd-rbac-clusterrole-rolebinding:inventory\" cannot list resource \"nodes\" in API group \"\" at the cluster scope"; Deployment node-inventory has 0 of 1 replicas ready

evidence.what: container inventory exited with code 1 (Error), restarted 6 times
last lines of container inventory's log (run that exited)
evidence.detail: Error from server (Forbidden): nodes is forbidden: User "system:serviceaccount:kd-rbac-clusterrole-rolebinding:inventory" cannot list resource "nodes" in API group "" at the cluster scope

evidence.what: RoleBinding inventory-reads-nodes grants ClusterRole kd-rbac-clusterrole-rolebinding-node-reader to ServiceAccount inventory

findings.fix: Bind ClusterRole kd-rbac-clusterrole-rolebinding-node-reader with a ClusterRoleBinding instead: kubectl create clusterrolebinding inventory-kd-rbac-clusterrole-rolebinding-node-reader --clusterrole=kd-rbac-clusterrole-rolebinding-node-reader --serviceaccount=kd-rbac-clusterrole-rolebinding:inventory.
